summary: Fixed the Major (CI-safe start ledger constants) and Minors 2 and 3, plus Nits 5 and 6; left Nits 4 and 7.

findings.detail: Dropped git show/execSync; hard-coded the seven start-commit wallMs values as START_WALL_MS.
22 B9 now samples facility nodes; riding episodes are capped at the number of stations that appeared during the sample, besides the 2.2 s limit.
Gallery spec leaves play, then waits for a fresh play before each still (full and reduced). The stills were not re-shot by hand; the spec ran and passed.
Accepted by the reviewer; design question.
Comment naming the E6+ Quasar -1880 precedent at the -2000 bound.
spotOf now returns its point p; the guest path uses it, so no non-null assertion.

limitations: The cap in the 22 B9 check counts facility nodes that were new since the first sample; a station that leaves and returns would count once.
